title: Where to take the MyaOS desktop app
decision: Pick one direction (A to F) for the MyaOS desktop app and one owner for task data.

options.label: Mission Control: one real job end to end
Keep the app as it is

bezos.reason: Choosing the direction and its reversibility is this pillar

graham.reason: Real demand is open with no paying customer

hormozi.reason: Who pays and how much, pillar materially affected

wickman.reason: Can the runtime and desktop run without the founder holding them together

buffett.reason: Cash over 3 to 9 months, and the downside of a long rebuild

musk.reason: The real constraint, and how much of the app can be cut

brief: MyaOS desktop app is mostly simulated: jobs, approvals, and dashboard numbers are not real, and its SQLite store is split from the Node runtime's task files. Pre-revenue, 3 to 9 months runway, no fixed deadline, no paying customer yet. The team leans to A with the runtime owning task data.
assumptions: Small founding team, founder time is the scarce resource (assumed)
Code-level findings only; the app has not been run end to end
